block.rationale: Fork-test FORK_BLOCK. The Aave V2 market is frozen/winding down so balances are slow-moving, but aToken/variableDebt accrue interest every block — the fork test asserts equality against the canonical balanceOf at the SAME forked block rather than hardcoding constants, so the amounts below are a captured reference, not an assertion. Refork + recapture right before user handoff for a minutes-fresh dashboard cross-check.

instance.note: Mainnet-only, single instance. The instance coordinate passed to setMetaInstances is the ProtocolDataProvider (widened to bytes32). positionId = abi.encode(LendingPool, reserve) — LendingPool resolved via the V2 getLendingPool() override (V3 uses getPool()).

holders.label: PURE_USDC_SUPPLIER
notes: Single-leg case: large USDC supply with usageAsCollateral = true, so the adapter emits it as Collateral (not Supplied).
Exercises the credit branch + the usageAsCollateral -> Collateral kind selection.

holders.label: STETH_SUPPLY_USDC_BORROW
notes: Multi-leg case: stETH collateral + USDC variable debt (+ a USDC dust collateral leg). Exercises Collateral + Borrowed in one holder, across two reserves.
Stable debt is intentionally NOT reported (governance-disabled on Aave V2) — only variable debt.

ground_truth.method: independent canonical balanceOf (NOT a Python re-derivation)
ground_truth.detail: The adapter reads ProtocolDataProvider.getUserReserveData(asset, account) for the aToken balance and variable debt. The fork test cross-checks each emitted amount against the reserve token's own balanceOf — aToken.balanceOf for credit legs, variableDebtToken.balanceOf for the borrow leg (tokens resolved via getReserveTokensAddresses) — a DIFFERENT call path that yields the same canonical value at the same forked block. Plus protocolId == AAVE_V2_LENDING, the correct PositionKind (Collateral/Supplied/Borrowed), positionId pool == LendingPool (the getLendingPool override), and the describePosition label.

naming_enhancement.title: describePosition now surfaces the market id
naming_enhancement.detail: Bundled with this verification. describePosition returns "<reserve symbol> position (<market id>)". For V2 the market id is "Aave genesis market" (resolved via LendingPool.getAddressesProvider().getMarketId()). Aave V2 has a single market, so there is no Core/Prime distinction here — the multi-market disambiguation matters on Aave V3 (Core = "Aave Ethereum Market", Lido/Prime = "Aave V3 Lido Ethereum"), demonstrated in the dashboard on holder 0x408ea1bC71ec2562ABCB27520cf7077718403496. On-chain the label is the canonical getMarketId(); the Core/Prime UI branding is an app-side alias.
